# Load Dataset

```{r}
data <- read.csv("/Users/donghyunpark/Documents/Seoul National University/3rd year 1st semester/Data mining/2차 프로젝트/Dataset/train_set_encoded.csv", fileEncoding = "euc-kr")
```

## Pre processing

```{r}
data <- data[, 1:45]
data$target <- as.factor(data$target)
```

```{r}
# 표준화 함수
normalizer <- function(x) {
  return((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
}
```

```{r}
for(i in 1:45){
  if(i == 4) next
  data[,i] = normalizer(data[,i])
}
```

# LDA

```{r, warning = FALSE}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
threshold_grid <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = 51)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  for(CV in 1:K){
  ########################################################################################
  # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
  ########################################################################################
        
    CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
    train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
    train_index <- c(1:n) 
    train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
    test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
    test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
    #################################################################
    # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
    #################################################################
    # Prior은 비율로 정의됨.
    Model <- lda(target ~ ., data = data, subset = train_index)
        
    for(threshold in threshold_grid){
      prob_pred <- predict(Model, newdata = test, type = "response")
      prob_pred <- prob_pred$posterior[,2]
      pred <- rep(0, test_rowNum)
      pred[prob_pred > threshold] <- 1
        
      # Update Scores
      Accuracy_LDA[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_LDA[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
      FPR_LDA[[seed]] <- c(FPR_LDA[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
      FNR_LDA[[seed]] <- c(FNR_LDA[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
      F1_LDA[[seed]] <- c(F1_LDA[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))  
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_LDA <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(threshold_grid)){
    CVAccuracy_LDA[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_LDA[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_LDA[[seed]][param1 + length(threshold_grid) * (0:(K-1))]))
    CVFPR_LDA[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_LDA[[seed]], mean(FPR_LDA[[seed]][param1 + length(threshold_grid) * (0:(K-1))]))
    CVFNR_LDA[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_LDA[[seed]], mean(FNR_LDA[[seed]][param1 + length(threshold_grid) * (0:(K-1))]))
    CVF1_LDA[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_LDA[[seed]], mean(F1_LDA[[seed]][param1 + length(threshold_grid) * (0:(K-1))]))
  }
}
```

# Accuracy

```{r}
LDA_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_LDA)
colnames(LDA_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
LDA_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(LDA_Accuracy)))

LDA_Accuracy <- LDA_Accuracy%>%
  gather(key = "threshold", value = "Accuracy")

LDA_Accuracy_mean <- LDA_Accuracy%>%
  group_by(threshold)%>%
  summarise(Accuracy_mean = mean(Accuracy)) 

LDA_Accuracy_mean%>%
  arrange(desc(Accuracy_mean))%>%
  head(10)
```

```{r}
LDA_Accuracy
```


```{r}
ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(data = LDA_Accuracy%>%
  filter(threshold %in% c("V21","V22","V23","V24","V25","V26","V27","V29","V30","V31")), aes(x = Accuracy, y = threshold, color = threshold))+
  geom_point(data = LDA_Accuracy_mean%>%
               filter(threshold %in% c("V21","V22","V23","V24","V25","V26","V27","V29","V30","V31")), aes(x = Accuracy_mean, y = threshold))
```

# F score

```{r}
LDA_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_LDA)
colnames(LDA_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
LDA_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(LDA_F1)))

LDA_F1 <- LDA_F1%>%
  gather(key = "threshold", value = "F1")

LDA_F1_mean <- LDA_F1%>%
  group_by(threshold)%>%
  summarise(F1_mean = mean(F1)) 

LDA_F1_mean%>%
  arrange(desc(F1_mean))%>%
  head(10)
```

```{r}
LDA_F1
```

```{r}
ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(data = LDA_F1%>%
  filter(threshold %in% c("V13","V14","V15","V16","V17","V18","V19","V20","V21","V22")), aes(x = F1, y = threshold, color = threshold))+
  geom_point(data = LDA_F1_mean%>%
               filter(threshold %in% c("V13","V14","V15","V16","V17","V18","V19","V20","V21","V22")), aes(x = F1_mean, y = threshold))
```
